subject: Private deployment: architecture review and next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Park <anna.park@fintechtoday.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private deployment: architecture review and next steps

Hi Anna / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good discussion and appreciate the transparency on compliance and network constraints. Quick recap of what I took away: 
- Target: private/VPC deployment in your AWS accounts (no cross-account data plane)
- Key constraints: strict egress firewall rules, SOC2 controls, traffic must stay in us-west-2, and your infra team needs host-level audit logs retained for 90 days
- Success metric for pilot: 3 qps sustained with P95 latency < 250ms for 2k token sequences during business hours

Next step: schedule a focused architecture review / technical deep dive with your infra & security folks so our engineers can map the network, IAM, and KMS flows. Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Mar 4, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Mar 5, 14:00–15:00
- Mon Mar 9, 09:00–10:00

Please let me know which works and who from your infra/security team will join (suggested: Elliot Gray for infra, and your security lead). I attached a short deck that outlines the Private/VPC options and an initial mutual action plan that we can iterate on.

If none of the times work, paste a couple of options and I’ll align with Marissa (our infra lead) and Vivek (eng manager).

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0181

Attachments: RW-Private-VPC-Deck-v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Anna Park <anna.park@fintechtoday.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@acme-payments.com>, Elliot Gray <elliot.gray@fintechtoday.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: architecture review and next steps

Thanks Karthik — good summary. Wed Mar 4 at 10:00 PST would work for us. I'll confirm Elliot but pretty sure he's available.

A couple quick asks before the call so we can prep:
- Can your team share the typical CIDR ranges we expect for the Redwoods nodes (public vs private subnets)?
- Any requirements around egress IP allowlists or SNI-based egress?

I'll loop in our security lead on the invite once Elliot confirms. Could you include a short agenda in the calendar invite (30–45 mins).

Anna Park
Director of Infrastructure, FinTech Today
anna.park@fintechtoday.com

--
Anna included Tom for visibility

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-03-02T17:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: architecture review and next steps

Great — Wed Mar 4, 10:00–10:45 PST is confirmed on our side. Marissa (our private deployment lead) will join to walk through the VPC topology and KMS/IAM flows.

Agenda (30–45 mins):
1) Quick goals & success criteria (5 min)
2) VPC & subnet layout options (10–15 min)
3) KMS/IAM and audit/logging options (10 min)
4) Network requirements & action items (10 min)

Marissa — can you lead the VPC/KMS section and call out the default CIDR recommendations (we generally suggest a /20 for production pools, plus separate /24s for management)?

I created a tentative calendar invite and attach the .ics file here; Meet link: https://meet.google.com/rw-internal-arch-review. Please accept and feel free to add specific agenda items.

Attachments: arch-review-invite.ics

Thanks — see you Wed,
Karthik

Subject: Fwd: Private deployment: architecture review and next steps

Forwarding the thread so I can add a couple prep notes for the Wed architecture review.

On Mon, Mar 2, 2026 at 3:12 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Anna / Tom —
> 
> Thanks again for the call earlier — good discussion and appreciate the transparency on compliance and network constraints. Quick recap of what I took away: 
> - Target: private/VPC deployment in your AWS accounts (no cross-account data plane)
> - Key constraints: strict egress firewall rules, SOC2 controls, traffic must stay in us-west-2, and your infra team needs host-level audit logs retained for 90 days
> 
> Next step: schedule a focused architecture review / technical deep dive with your infra & security folks so our engineers can map the network, IAM, and KMS flows. Proposed slots (PST): Wed Mar 4, 10:00–11:00; Thu Mar 5, 14:00–15:00; Mon Mar 9, 09:00–10:00

Prep notes (from Marissa):
- Please have a representative who owns VPC peering/VPN and your KMS admin join so we can validate key import vs. customer-managed keys flows
- If possible, share the VPC expectation sheet (CIDRs, NAT/gateway pattern, proxy/SNI egress) before Wed; even a short list in the calendar event helps
- We'll bring a short diagram of three deployment modes (dedicated-hosted bridge, single-tenant VPC, and on-prem air-gapped) and reference our audit/logging exporters

If you can drop the CIDR and any egress allowlist details as Anna requested, we'll slot those into the slides.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole | Lead Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
